(NYSE: PLTR) that integrated BlackSky’s commercial satellite imagery and analytics into Palantir Foundry, Palantir’s enterprise platform.

relations.text: BlackSkyとSpire Globalは、船舶を追跡するリアルタイムの海上監視サービスを共同で作った
relations.text_en: BlackSky and Spire Global teamed up to create a real-time commercially available Maritime Custody Service

source.label: BlackSky の発表
source.quote: BlackSky Technology Inc. (NYSE: BKSY ) and Spire Global, Inc. (NYSE: SPIR ) have teamed up to create a real-time, commercially available Maritime Custody Service (MCS) that can automatically detect, identify and track more than 270 thousand vessels worldwide in open water, along rivers and canals, and while docked at port.
